# Durable evidence for the omp claims in runtime/watchdog/HOST_MECHANICS.md.
# Every block below is verbatim output from a read-only inspection command
# re-run on this machine on 2026-07-10 (omp v16.1.15, macOS). Re-run any block
# to reproduce. HOST_MECHANICS.md cites these blocks by their [O-n] tag.

# ==== [O-1] omp version ====
# $ omp --version
omp/16.1.15

# ==== [O-2] Session storage dir env var / default (from omp --help) ====
# $ omp --help | grep -i 'session storage\|PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR'
      --session-dir=<value>           Directory for session storage and lookup
  PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR        - Session storage directory (default: ~/.omp/agent)

# ==== [O-3] Session files are sharded by a cwd-slug directory ====
# $ ls -1d ~/.omp/agent/sessions/*/ | head -3
/Users/zeke/.omp/agent/sessions/--private-tmp--/
/Users/zeke/.omp/agent/sessions/--private-tmp-claude-501--Users-zeke-dev-z-harness-381af3ca-21cf-4e03-88e3-1166fe571ef2-scratchpad--/
/Users/zeke/.omp/agent/sessions/-.hermes-hermes-agent/
# => launch cwd with '/' replaced by '-' becomes the shard dir name; each dir
#    holds one JSONL per chat. Many files per dir is the DURABLE corroboration
#    for per-chat file creation (the live /new "New session started" keystroke
#    observation is scoped to the grounding run in HOST_MECHANICS.md, same
#    treatment as codex [C-2]).

# ==== [O-4] Non-transcript state incl. plaintext-credential hazard ====
# $ ls -1 ~/.omp/agent/*.db ~/.omp/agent/*.yml
/Users/zeke/.omp/agent/agent.db
/Users/zeke/.omp/agent/config.yml
/Users/zeke/.omp/agent/history.db
/Users/zeke/.omp/agent/models.db
/Users/zeke/.omp/agent/models.yml
# => models.yml / config.yml / *.db are NOT transcripts. models.yml holds
#    provider apiKey values in plaintext; the watchdog must read only files
#    under sessions/.

# ==== [O-5] Context-window denominator is NOT in the transcript; use `omp models` ====
# $ omp models --help  (semantics)
List, search, and refresh available models
USAGE
  $ omp models [ACTION] [PATTERN] [FLAGS]
ARGUMENTS
  ACTION    ls (default) | find | refresh | canonical | <provider>
FLAGS
      --json               Output JSON
# $ omp models | grep -i 'gpt-5.5'  (context column, K = 1000 tokens)
│ gpt-5.5-extra-high            │    200K │     64K │ -                       │ no     │
│ gpt-5.5-high                  │    200K │     64K │ -                       │ no     │
│ gpt-5.5-low                   │    200K │     64K │ -                       │ no     │
# => `omp models` (or `omp models --json` for machine parsing) is the second,
#    session-independent source the omp adapter needs for a percentage
#    denominator. gpt-5.5 = 200K context on this machine.

# ==== [O-6] Assistant message usage/contextSnapshot + append-only growth ====
# real file: ~/.omp/agent/sessions/-dev-z-harness/2026-07-10T02-17-39-823Z_019f49d0-f8ef-7000-b46a-fa3fdf9bd13f.jsonl
# (parsed assistant `message` events, in file order:)
line 6: totalTokens=28854 stopReason=toolUse contextSnapshot=present promptTokens=28674
line 8: totalTokens=30984 stopReason=toolUse contextSnapshot=present promptTokens=30764
line 10: totalTokens=31119 stopReason=toolUse contextSnapshot=present promptTokens=31059
# => usage.totalTokens & contextSnapshot.promptTokens present per assistant
#    message; values increase monotonically down the file == append-only, no
#    rewrite of earlier lines. (Matches usage_nominal.json, which excerpts the
#    line-10 message of this same file.)

# ==== [O-7] Error-stopReason turns zero the usage and drop contextSnapshot ====
# $ grep -l '"stopReason":"error"' ~/.omp/agent/sessions/-dev-z-harness/*.jsonl | head -1
#   -> 2026-06-24T03-57-41-594Z_019ef7c6-cd5a-7000-bc8f-5e9745ee7678.jsonl
# (parsed the error message:)
totalTokens= 0 contextSnapshot= ABSENT errorMessage= Codex error event: The usage limit has been reached (code=us...
# => an error turn reports a false 0% if trusted naively. (Matches
#    usage_missing_or_degraded.json example_1.)
